**Replaces an earlier claim**, retired on 2026-09-11 to the [archive](ARCHIVE.md#C-DZ-OLD-Z8-CLASSES): The share was not the held one: enums.py, counting every row, finds the placeholder on a smaller share of the rows than the one given.

<a id="C-DZ-Z8-NULL"></a>
### The null permutes the composition channels together across casts within station and calendar month, keeping each channel's marginals and the station and season structure, and rebuilds the apportionment a stated number of times; the observed unique variance must beat that distribution, and the same permutation serves the constant and the artefact.

`C-DZ-Z8-NULL` · **stipulated** — a rule this project sets itself, with its reason

Said on [hypodrafts/Z8.md](hypodrafts/Z8.md).

**Why it follows:** Casts are clustered by station, seasonal and autocorrelated, and the channels share a station's mean level with Kd, so a regression's nominal null would overstate; the number of permutations is a stated value.

- **claim** — FDOM runs only over the counted years, so a test on both composition channels is confined to them, and before them the extract holds no other channel for dissolved organic matter. ([`C-DZ-Z8-FDOMSPAN`](CLAIMS.md#C-DZ-Z8-FDOMSPAN))

Carries a clock value on every genuine row, though for much of the old record the value is a filled-in default rather than a time (scripts/clockzone.py); several parameters appear under more than one unit - see DATA_SOURCES.md.
- **held** — Distinct values. data/derived/enums.json: every distinct value of every column of kemi and ctd, counted.
- **script** — enums.py. Counts the values of the ODA extracts' categorical columns over every row.
- **script** — fetch_oda.py: the water-chemistry topic. Its TOPICS entry kemi is the ODA node `Emne_10_11`, described in the code as Vandkemi / Næringsstof og Miljøfarligt stof and read off the Hav topic tree. No entry reaches Sedimentkemi, Bundfauna or the stream topics, and the argument parser accepts only the TOPICS keys.
- **external** — Wikipedia: diuron, a herbicide: “is an algicide and herbicide of the aryl urea class that inhibits photosynthesis” ([`OQ-WIKI-DIURON`](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Diuron), pinned). An algicide and herbicide of the aryl urea class that inhibits photosynthesis.
- **external** — Wikipedia: Diuron is another name for it: “Karmex, Diuron, Direx” ([`OQ-WIKI-DIURON`](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Diuron), pinned). Its other names include Diuron.
- **external** — Wikipedia: atrazine, a triazine herbicide: “is a chlorinated herbicide of the triazine class” ([`OQ-WIKI-ATRAZINE`](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Atrazine), pinned). A chlorinated herbicide of the triazine class.
- **external** — Wikipedia: atrazine to hydroxyatrazine: “atrazine to hydroxyatrazine” ([`HY-WIKI-ATZA`](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Atrazine_chlorohydrolase), pinned). Bacteria degrade atrazine to hydroxyatrazine.
- **external** — Wikipedia: simazine, a triazine herbicide: “Simazine is an herbicide of the triazine class” ([`OQ-WIKI-SIMAZINE`](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Simazine), pinned). An herbicide of the triazine class.
- **assumption** — Hydroxysimazin is simazine's hydroxy form. The water chemistry's `Hydroxysimazin` is read as simazine's hydroxy degradation product, by analogy with hydroxyatrazine and atrazine; no document pinned here says so.

**Assessed** — no script computes this. It is a reading or a judgement, assessed by a person.

<a id="C-OQ-J1-PCT"></a>
### R has no physical units: the unit pct is carried on exactly as many records as light attenuation and oxygen saturation together, and no unit of the column is a coefficient per metre, so the attenuation channel is a percentage transmission.

`C-OQ-J1-PCT` · **argued** — follows by reasoning from what it rests on - the argument is given in full

Said on [openproblems/J1.md](openproblems/J1.md).

**Why it follows:** enums.py counts the records per unit and per parameter; the pct count equals the sum of those two parameters, oxygen saturation is a percentage, and the list of units holds no coefficient per metre. The reading is void if the match of totals hides a swap (A-OQ-UNITMATCH); the generator refuses the page if the totals stop matching.

**Replaces an earlier claim**, retired on 2026-09-11 to the [archive](ARCHIVE.md#C-OQ-OLD-J1-UNITS): The parameter-by-unit counts came from a one-off pass that was not kept and differ from the extract held now; g/l and kg/m3 are one unit under two labels, so the stated factor for density was wrong; the column-shifted records are counted by nothing held; and FDOM does carry a unit.

<a id="C-OQ-J1-PATH"></a>
### A transmission becomes a coefficient only through the path length the light travelled, and no column of the extract records one.

`C-OQ-J1-PATH` · **argued** — follows by reasoning from what it rests on - the argument is given in full

Said on [openproblems/J1.md](openproblems/J1.md).

**Why it follows:** Attenuation relates to the optical path length through the medium (the Beer-Lambert law); the extract's header and its unit, probe and remark values were searched for a path length and hold none.

**Replaces an earlier claim**, retired on 2026-09-11 to the [archive](ARCHIVE.md#C-OQ-OLD-J1-UNITS): The parameter-by-unit counts came from a one-off pass that was not kept and differ from the extract held now; g/l and kg/m3 are one unit under two labels, so the stated factor for density was wrong; the column-shifted records are counted by nothing held; and FDOM does carry a unit.

The ODA topic's own documentation was not searched.

<a id="C-OQ-J1-VACUOUS"></a>
### The shrink-by-P test is vacuous here, because P is fitted rather than measured: FDOM's contribution is a coefficient of the regression that forms R, and no channel of the extract measures an absorption.

`C-OQ-J1-VACUOUS` · **argued** — follows by reasoning from what it rests on - the argument is given in full

Said on [openproblems/J1.md](openproblems/J1.md).

**Why it follows:** Adding a regressor to a least-squares fit cannot increase its in-sample residual, so adding FDOM reduces R by construction; the part removed is estimated by the same fit, so the residual rule has no independent P. The extract's parameters include no absorption measurement.

<a id="C-OQ-J1-PROXY"></a>

Said on [openproblems/J1.md](openproblems/J1.md).

## openproblems/R6.md

<a id="C-OQ-R6-CLASS"></a>
### Missing: experiment, constructive. [R6](openproblems/R6.md "Sulphide locks the iron that would hold the phosphate")'s discriminator is a rate against a ratio, and its causal clause is comparative; a field record varies sulphate only together with salinity, organic loading, iron supply and temperature, so the contrast has to be built in a core incubation.

`C-OQ-R6-CLASS` · **argued** — follows by reasoning from what it rests on - the argument is given in full

Said on [openproblems/R6.md](openproblems/R6.md).

**Why it follows:** The register gives the discriminator as sediment iron-to-sulphur and iron-to-phosphorus ratios against phosphate release rate, and the prediction as more release under anoxia because of the salt. In the field sulphate follows salinity, and salinity gradients also carry the other terms, so only a manipulation can hold them fixed.

<a id="C-OQ-R6-ENDPOINT"></a>
### Free sulphide in the water column is what remains after the sediment's iron buffer is spent: a detector of the endpoint, not of the process.

`C-OQ-R6-ENDPOINT` · **argued** — follows by reasoning from what it rests on - the argument is given in full

Said on [openproblems/R6.md](openproblems/R6.md).

**Why it follows:** The national method describes the sediment's buffer capacity as its ability to retain sulphide, with oxidised iron binding it before it reaches the oxic zone; sulphide in the water is what passes that buffer.

```mermaid
graph BT
  C-OQ-R6-ENDPOINT("Free sulphide in the water column is what remains after th...")
  E-OQ-TA14-RETAIN[("NOVA method: what the · buffer capacity is")]
  E-OQ-TA14-BIND[("NOVA method: sulphide meets · iron below the oxic zone")]
  E-OQ-TA14-RETAIN --> C-OQ-R6-ENDPOINT
  E-OQ-TA14-BIND --> C-OQ-R6-ENDPOINT
  style C-OQ-R6-ENDPOINT fill:#173a26,stroke:#3fb950,color:#d7ffe4
  style E-OQ-TA14-RETAIN fill:#3d3357,stroke:#a58cf0,color:#e6edf3
  style E-OQ-TA14-BIND fill:#3d3357,stroke:#a58cf0,color:#e6edf3
```

- **external** — NOVA method: what the buffer capacity is: “Sedimentets evne til at tilbageholde reducerede forbindelser, specielt svovlbrinte” ([`TA-NOVA-1998-K14`](https://ecos.au.dk/fileadmin/ecos/Fagdatacentre/Marin/TA_NOVA_1998/Kap14.pdf), pinned). The sediment's ability to retain reduced compounds, sulphide above all, is its sulphide buffer capacity.
- **external** — NOVA method: sulphide meets iron below the oxic zone: “diffunderer op mod sedimentoverfladen” ([`TA-NOVA-1998-K14`](https://ecos.au.dk/fileadmin/ecos/Fagdatacentre/Marin/TA_NOVA_1998/Kap14.pdf), pinned). Sulphide formed by sulphate reduction diffuses up towards the surface and, before it reaches the oxic zone, reacts with oxidised iron and is bound as iron sulphide.

<a id="C-OQ-R6-CENSOR"></a>

<a id="C-OQ-R6-NULL"></a>
### The naive null, that anoxic sediment releases no more phosphate than oxic, is wrong and would hand [R6](openproblems/R6.md "Sulphide locks the iron that would hold the phosphate") an unearned win: under anoxia phosphate is released by the breakdown of organic matter, and iron-reducing bacteria free iron-bound phosphate, whether or not sulphide forms.

`C-OQ-R6-NULL` · **argued** — follows by reasoning from what it rests on - the argument is given in full

Said on [openproblems/R6.md](openproblems/R6.md).

**Why it follows:** SR323 describes both routes of release: mineralisation freeing phosphate, and iron-reducing bacteria mobilising iron-bound phosphate beside the chemical route through sulphide.

- **external** — SR323: iron-reducing bacteria free phosphate: “Jernreducerende bakterier mobiliserer det jernbundne fosfat” ([`OQ-SR323`](https://dce2.au.dk/pub/SR323.pdf), pinned). Iron-reducing bacteria mobilise iron-bound phosphate in their respiration; sulphide does so by a chemical reaction with oxidised iron.

<a id="C-OQ-R6-LICENSE"></a>
### A successful incubation licenses one narrow thing - in this sediment, sulphate changes phosphate release per unit mineralisation by a factor - and not a Danish phosphorus budget, a water-body allocation, the Baltic feedback, or the freshwater comparison; it tests the step, not the system claim.

`C-OQ-R6-LICENSE` · **argued** — follows by reasoning from what it rests on - the argument is given in full

Said on [openproblems/R6.md](openproblems/R6.md).

**Why it follows:** One sediment is one sediment; the hypothesis's unit is depositional history, not a map; the freshwater comparison needs the same dose series on lake sediment, and lake and marine sediments differ in more than sulphate.

- **the argument alone** — nothing further is cited: the reasoning above is the whole of it, for the reader to judge
